title: Record the patched Mermaid minimum in the UI manifest
outcome: Raise the Mermaid manifest minimum to the chosen patched release floor in a separate reviewed and gated dependency change; preserve a coherent lockfile. The current ^11.14.0 range permits older compatible versions while the reviewed lock pins11.16.1. Default npm update normally seeks newer compatible versions: this is documentation of the minimum in dependency metadata, not a deterministic downgrade bug.
acceptance: Record the patched Mermaid minimum in the UI manifest is done
